content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Primarily an electric utility generating and selling power, with telecom as a secondary line."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Software and IT services vendor for telecom operators, not a network owner selling capacity or broadband."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Mainly a wireless phone carrier with towers and island markets, not a leased fiber network or rural broadband business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Diversified holding company with billboards and insurance; broadband is only one unrelated segment."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone and web hosting sold to small businesses, not network leasing or residential broadband."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Contractor that builds and maintains networks for carriers, rather than owning networks or selling broadband."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Owns fiber and cable networks and sells broadband, wireless and managed network services to consumers and carriers."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Designs communications software and hardware appliances for carriers, not network infrastructure or broadband service."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Rural fiber owner selling residential broadband subscriptions and business network services over its own network."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Business is mainly wireless phone service with device sales; wireline broadband is a smaller part."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Satellite broadband and defense electronics manufacturer, not terrestrial fiber or copper network leasing."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Makes network test equipment, optical components and security materials, not network ownership or service."}]}
